about.title: Personal Injury Help in Buena Park, California
about.longDescription: Buena Park is a city of about 83,000 people, best known to visitors for Knott's Berry Farm and known to residents for the everyday traffic on Beach Boulevard, La Palma Avenue and Western Avenue, along with SR-91. Public records show those four corridors carry the highest collision counts in the city. In 2025, the most recent finalized year, Buena Park recorded 338 injury collisions. Behind that figure are 483 people who were hurt and 8 who lost their lives. Reports tend to cluster on Fridays between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m., when the workweek ends and the roads fill up. If one of those numbers is you or someone in your family, the paperwork that follows can feel heavier than the injury itself. Our team is here to help shoulder that burden. We listen to what happened, then guide you through your personal injury claim in Orange County. Our attorneys work on contingency, meaning they collect a fee only if your case ends in a recovery. You keep control of every decision.

whyChoose.title: What California Law Means for Your Buena Park Claim

items.title: The two-year window is real
items.desc: Most injury claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of injury. Claims against a city, county or state agency can carry a much shorter notice deadline, sometimes just six months.

items.title: Being partly at fault does not end your case
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault. If you share some responsibility, your recovery is reduced by your percentage of fault, but you are not barred from recovering.

items.title: No cap on pain and suffering in ordinary cases
items.desc: For a typical injury claim in California, there is no statutory ceiling on non-economic damages such as pain, loss of enjoyment and emotional distress.

items.title: Nothing out of pocket to hire an attorney
items.desc: Our attorneys work on contingency. That means no fee unless there is a recovery, and you pay nothing up front.

items.question: Where do collisions in Buena Park tend to happen?
items.answer: Public collision records for Buena Park show the highest counts along Beach Boulevard, SR-91, La Palma Avenue and Western Avenue. These are simply the corridors with the most reported incidents, which tracks with how much traffic they carry. Reports also tend to peak on Fridays between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m.

items.question: How long do I have to file an injury claim in California?
items.answer: For most personal injury claims, California allows two years from the date of the injury. If a government entity is involved, such as a city vehicle or a hazard on public property, a formal claim may need to be filed within six months. An attorney can help pin down which deadline applies to your situation.

items.question: What if I was partly responsible for the crash?
items.answer: California uses pure comparative fault, so sharing some blame does not disqualify you. Your recovery is reduced by your percentage of fault, but it is not eliminated. This is one reason it helps to have an attorney examine how fault is being assigned.

items.question: How do you help with my injury claim?

items.question: What will it cost me to hire an attorney?
items.answer: Our attorneys handle injury cases on contingency. That means their fee comes out of a recovery if there is one, and there is no fee if there is not. You will not be asked to pay anything up front.
